Digital Boxing uses sensor-embedded silicone dummies to track punches, syncing with 3D visuals for hyper-realistic strikes. Combines immersive stress relief, fitness, and gaming in one punch-perfect experience.



>> Features of Interactive Boxing:


  • Sensor-Embedded Dummy: Silicone training dummy equipped with pressure and motion sensors to track every punch.

  • 3D Visual Sync: Each strike is mirrored with real-time 3D animations and immersive sound effects.

  • Multiple Game Modes: Includes fitness routines, reflex drills, reaction-based games, and versus mode.

  • Performance Feedback: Provides metrics like reaction time, strike power, punch frequency, and accuracy.

  • Adjustable Difficulty: Adaptive AI sets custom challenge levels for beginners to pros.

  • Safe & Durable Materials: Made from high-resilience silicone for safe impact and long-lasting use.

  • Compact Setup: Easily installable in gyms, arcades, training centers, or even home environments.



>> Advantages and Applications for the Interactive Boxing:


Stress Relief Through Impact: Designed for emotional release and mental wellness via physical exertion.


Engaging Fitness: Burns calories while building coordination, endurance, and strength.


Skill Training: Ideal for improving punching technique, timing, and reflexes.

Gamified Experience: Makes exercise fun and competitive with scoring and game dynamics.


Wide Audience Appeal: Great for teens, adults, athletes, and even casual gamers.


Versatile Installation: Perfect for fitness clubs, boxing studios, shopping malls, amusement centers, and esports venues.



>> Product Number: LJST023


  • Floor area: 4m*4m*3m

  • Number of people: 1-3 person

  • Participation time: 3-5 minutes

  • Power: 300w



>> FAQs for Interactive Boxing:


Q1: How does the dummy register punches?

A1: The silicone dummy is embedded with smart sensors that detect impact pressure, location, and speed.


Q2: Is the equipment safe for heavy use?

A2: Yes, the dummy is made from high-resilience silicone, offering both safety and durability for frequent punches.


Q3: Can it be used for serious boxing training?

A3: While designed primarily for entertainment and fitness, the system also supports technique improvement and reflex training for beginner and intermediate users.


Q4: What kind of feedback does it give?

A4: Users get real-time stats such as punch speed, strength, accuracy, and reaction time via the display interface.


Q5: Is it suitable for kids or seniors?

A5: Yes, difficulty levels can be adjusted, making it safe and enjoyable for various age groups and fitness levels.
